name: ITG Internet
summary: Riverina NSW local dialup + ADSL ISP (The I.T. Group Pty Ltd, ~2002); defunct (ACN 105 313 782).

events.details: Defunct. Retail ISP homepage ran to Apr 2011 and was hollowed to an itgroup.net.au redirect by Aug 2011 — far later than the current c. 2005, tighter than the proposed 'by Dec 2014'.
